product_family: Dify is an open-source agentic workflow builder platform for building, deploying, and scaling AI applications. Key features include RAG pipeline support, multi-LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local models), workflow automation, no-code interface, and marketplace for plugins. Deployment options: Cloud (SaaS) and self-hosted (Community/Premium/Enterprise editions).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II Certification was assessed by independent auditing firm Sensiba and ensures continuous compliant operations across data security, availability, integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001:2022 Certification was assessed by independent auditing firm Johanson and ensures that Dify employs a systematic approach to data protection and effectively mitigates security risks.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Dify strictly adheres to the requirements of the EU General Data Protection Regulation through comprehensive Data Processing Agreements (DPA), Privacy Policy maintenance, and annual Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) updates.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: No evidence that Dify trains on customer data. Self-hosted deployments keep all data on-premise; Cloud deployments use AWS US-East with application data anonymized. No public claims of using customer data to improve models.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS enforced; security keys used for HMAC-SHA256 file URL signatures

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for third-party OAuth credentials and sensitive data

security.name: Authentication
security.value: JWT authentication, Session cookie signing, Two-step verification, MFA available in Enterprise edition

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Fine-grained access control; SSO (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2) in Enterprise edition; Centralized access control with role-based permissions

security.name: Data isolation
security.value: Multi-tenant architecture; Application data anonymized in Cloud version; Data stays on customer infrastructure in self-hosted deployments

security.name: Third-party integrations
security.value: Marketplace integrations vetted for privacy; Plugin developers required to declare data collection and link privacy policies

products.name: Dify Cloud
products.data_scope: User data stored in AWS US-East; Application data anonymized
products.notes: Managed service with no deployment required; includes free tier, Pro, and Team plans; all certifications apply

products.name: Dify Self-Hosted Community Edition
products.data_scope: All data remains on customer infrastructure; full data residency control
products.notes: Free, open-source; Docker, Kubernetes, VPS deployment; no vendor telemetry; customers responsible for security

products.name: Dify Self-Hosted Premium Edition
products.data_scope: All data remains on customer infrastructure; customer-managed data residency
products.notes: Commercial license required; advanced features; same compliance posture as Cloud but on-premise

products.name: Dify Self-Hosted Enterprise Edition
products.data_scope: Completely customer-managed; full data residency control with multi-region options via Kubernetes
products.notes: License required from business@dify.ai; multi-workspace, SSO, MFA, advanced permissions, load balancing, dedicated support, SLA options; designed for strict compliance and data residency requirements

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (Cloud); Open-source free (Self-hosted Community); Commercial license (Premium/Enterprise)
